rows.question: What is its architecture?
rows.text: NexusAI's architecture is a seven-stage pipeline per turn: 1. Clients: Streamlit web UI — Chat interface with live agent-activity, tracing and analytics tabs. Android app — Kotlin / Jetpack Compose client that consumes the same typed event stream. 2. Gateway: FastAPI + SSE — Streams typed events (tokens, agent status, final answer) to clients over Server-Sent Events. 3. Input guardrails: Flood control — Throttles bursts of requests before any model is called. Injection & toxicity checks — Blocked input is replaced with a placeholder, so it never re-enters conversation history. PII redaction…
